The Modesty House · design study II

Ten ways to build
the grid.

Ten variants of the photo grid now live on the Designers page. Same houses, same photography, same tokens throughout — what changes is the crop, the density, and where the name goes. Real brand images, pulled from the live catalogue. Open any variant to see it full width.

Variant 01 Square · name on the image on the site now

What is on the site now, for comparison. Five across, 1:1, the name set into the photograph over a scrim.

Variant 02 Portrait 3:4

The same tile, taller. Fashion is photographed vertically — a square crop cuts the garment off at the waist, and this stops doing that.

Variant 03 Caption beneath

No scrim, no type on the photograph. The image stays untouched and the name sits below it on parchment — the most legible of the ten, and the only one that never fights a busy picture.

Variant 04 Featured double

A vetted house takes a 2×2 tile. Makes the seal mean something spatially, and gives the page an editorial rhythm instead of an even field.

Variant 05 Continuous wall

No gaps and no border — the houses form one uninterrupted sheet of imagery. Strongest first impression, weakest for telling where one house ends and the next begins.

Oomah Haute Hijab Vela Scarves Veiled Niswa Fashion Zahraa The Label Modern Hijabi Voile Chic Jaida Culture Hijab Co Aab Inayah Nasiba Urban Modesty Hawaa Clothing KlayTheLabel Mariam's Collection LumosModesty
Variant 06 Duotone, colour on hover

Every image tinted to the house aubergine, releasing to full colour on hover. Solves a real problem: 58 first-product shots have 58 different backgrounds and light, and raw they look like a scrapbook.

Variant 07 Arched crop

The tile takes an arch. A borrowed shape rather than a neutral rectangle, and it reads as considered — but it crops the top of every garment, which is where the detail usually is.

Variant 08 Three across, large

Fewer houses per screen, each given room. Reads like a magazine rather than a directory — good if the roster is a curation to be admired, bad if someone is hunting for one name.

Variant 10 Index with thumbnails

The typographic ledger with a small square per row. Scannable like a list, still shows the clothes — and the only layout here where all 58 houses fit on one screen.

The index · 58 houses
Chic & Modesty France Hijabs & modest Oomah UK Trousers Haute Hijab New York Hijabs ✦ Editor's Vela Scarves USA Hijabs Veiled USA Hijabs & modest ✦ Verified Niswa Fashion Los Angeles Hijabs & abayas Zahraa The Label USA Hijabs Modern Hijabi USA Hijabs & modest Voile Chic Canada Hijabs & modest Jaida Canada Luxury hijabs Culture Hijab Co USA Hijabs Aab London Modest & abayas ✦ Verified

The photographs are real — each house's own first-product image, the same one the live page uses. That matters here: several of these variants stand or fall on how consistent the photography is across 58 shops, and it is not consistent. Variant 06 exists because of that.

Variant 06 shows one tile released to colour to stand for the hover state; on the real page every tile does that under the cursor.

The plates stay light in either theme — they depict a light site.
